title: Tim Taylor's hooded figure before his invention download

tellings.quote: morning he said grant the last thing I remember the night before I got that idea in my head I woke up and there was a hooded figure standing at the end of bed

plain: An inventor named Timothy Taylor says that the night before an idea for an invention came into his head, he woke to find "a hooded figure standing at the end of" his bed, and that this is the last thing he remembers. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it on the show as what Taylor told him, also crediting a book by someone he calls Pulko, and he offers it as a case where a strange visitor seems to come just before a sudden idea.
